messages:
Ivy: starting VoltEdge joint perf sweep planning. goal: validate perf/W and tuned kernel knobs for marketplace listing. need owners for telemetry, runs, and comms. @Mia can you confirm what board-level power telemetry you can share?
Rahul: acceptance idea: sustained perf/W improvement >8% vs baseline, 95th latency below target for interactive, and no diffs on eval set. numbers to be finalized.
Mia (VoltEdge): we can stream board_power_w, vrm_w, and bmc_temp_c at 1s. have an external Yokogawa for validation. can add per-slice power after a small firmware patch (3 business days).
Ivy: plan two-phase: phase1 baseline with current sensors for quick turn, phase2 per-slice after FW. who runs which?
Omar: Redwood will run phase1 in Dedicated reserved pool; VoltEdge lab will run phase2 long-run and meter-attached validation. Omar will post AMI/container.
Rahul: workloads: chat-longtail seq=512, batched throughput seq=256 batch=16, embed microbench. each 30m steady-state plus 2hr perf/W stability test. harness sample: `./run_bench --model rdx-13b --seq 512 --qps 150 --time 1800 --telemetry /tmp/volt_phase1.json`
Mia (VoltEdge): we'll provide meter CSV (ISO8601) and BMC schema. prefer 1s agg + raw on anomalies.
Ivy: legal note: partner ops needs a short data-sharing addendum signed before public announcement. won't block internal validation.
bench-bot: queued smoke run, will return quick pass/fail and link. :robot_face:
bench-bot: smoke run complete. telemetry endpoints reachable, harness started, 2 quick checks passed. logs: https://redwood.internal/bench/4801234567/smoke
Ivy: action items: 1) Mia: sensor schema + meter hookup by EOD tomorrow. 2) Omar: AMI/container + cluster spec by tomorrow. 3) Rahul: final acceptance thresholds and eval prompts by day after tomorrow. 4) bench-bot: smoke and post. reconvene after phase1 results (target Fri 10am PT). thanks! :rocket:
